instruction.text: There are 62 people on a train. 52 people get off. 34 people get on. How many people are on the train now?
There are 48 people in the school hall. 17 people leave the hall. 9 people enter the hall. How many people are in the hall now?
There are 85 people at a concert. 16 people leave. Then 54 more people also leave. How many people are at the concert now?
There are 8 children at the park. 15 children arrive. A few minutes later, 19 more children get to the park. How many children are at the park now?
There are 22 dogs at the kennel. 14 dogs get picked up by their owners. 38 dogs get dropped off. How many dogs are in the kennel now?
There are 87 people at a wedding. 26 people go home. An hour later, 38 more people go home. How many people are at the wedding now?
There are 32 children in the classroom. Another class of 29 children join them. Then, 14 children go outside. How many children are in the classroom now?
There are 54 people staying in a hotel. 29 people check out. 62 people check in. How many people are staying at the hotel now?
